name: ssf-shop
description: Search and discover fashion products from SSF SHOP using natural language.

interface.shortDescription: 프리미엄 패션 플랫폼의 기준, SSF SHOP
interface.longDescription: 빈폴, 구호, 준지 등 삼성물산의 대표 브랜드부터 산드로, 마쥬, 아미, 메종키츠네, 이세이 미야케, 르메르 등 글로벌 컨템포러리·럭셔리 브랜드까지 3,000여개의 브랜드의 정품 컬렉션을 Chat GPT에서 바로 탐색하세요. 원하는 스타일과 조건을 말하면 맞는 상품을 찾아 보여드립니다. 원하시는 상품을 선택하시면 SSF SHOP에서 안전하게 구매할 수 있습니다.
defaultPrompt: Find men's shirts sorted by price.

positive.description: Search for women's coats within a budget
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching women's coats within the requested price limit, with product names, prices, and links when available.

positive.description: Search by brand and product type
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant BEANPOLE knitwear products and clearly identify the brand and product details supplied by the catalog.

positive.description: Filter men's shirts and sort by price
positive.prompt: Find men's shirts sorted by price.
positive.expected_behavior: Return men's shirts sorted by price using the available product search results.
Return coats identified as cashmere in the product data, with useful prices and product links where available.
Return matching children's sneakers from SSF SHOP and state when no matching items are found.

negative.description: Do not claim to purchase products
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin supports product discovery only and cannot place an order.

negative.description: Do not claim account or order history access
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin does not access account or order history and direct the user to SSF SHOP if appropriate.

negative.description: Do not claim order cancellation capability
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin cannot cancel orders and direct the user to SSF SHOP customer support if appropriate.

review.commerce_description: This plugin helps users discover products. Purchases are completed securely on SSF SHOP; the plugin does not place orders or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission package for SSF SHOP product discovery.
